title: ProgressGym: Alignment with a Millennium of Moral Progress

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment against evolving historical human values across 9 centuries using progressive alignment challenges (PG-Follow, PG-Predict, PG-Coevolve) and measuring the cosine similarity of value embeddings.

Assessing model choices in 5,104 high-ambiguity moral scenarios based on the MoralChoice framework, the Moral Foundations Questionnaire, and the Integrated Worldview Framework to map 19 dimensions of basic morality, social morality, values, and worldviews.

Tracking the temporal evolution of political value dimensions such as 'democracy' and 'liberalism' from the 13th to the 21st centuries using Sentence-T5 embeddings and Support Vector Regression on historical text corpora.
Tracking the prominence and evolution of 'religion' as a value dimension over time using Support Vector Regression trained on GPT-4 annotated sentence embeddings from historical texts.
